scope: Arc Autopilot interrupted execution, durable recovery and user-facing recovery guidance

reproducedDefect.trigger: Activity insertion fails after the signed vault trade has been broadcast
reproducedDefect.before: A later worker cycle sees no pending activity and can submit another trade before reconciling the original transaction

isolatedReproduction.mode: Actual worker with isolated chain/provider/storage fixtures; no live mainnet transaction

changes: Prepare and locally sign the Arc vault transaction; compute its canonical hash before broadcast
Persist an authenticated encrypted transaction record in private KV independently of activity insertion
Bind recovery to exact owner, vault, Arc chain 5042, execution calldata, policy version, action nonce, amount, evidence hash, signer and 0.10 USDC maximum transaction gas
Use a key derived from the executor signing key and exact owner/vault; never put signed payloads in strategy/UI telemetry
Give pending recovery priority over ordinary analysis/risk cooldowns; attempt recovery once per strategy per cycle under its execution lease
Recover a missing activity row and query the known transaction hash before permitting another trade
Resend only the identical signed bytes while the original quote and unchanged unpaused vault policy remain valid
Verify a confirmed receipt against the known hash, factory-owned vault and execution event
Persist confirmed/failed activity durably before removing the independent recovery record
Keep an expired, policy-invalid, corrupt or key-incompatible unresolved transaction on Hold for operator reconciliation
Document transaction recovery and executor-key retention in README and English/Chinese app guides

checks: Arc Spot keeper limit, bracket and TP/SL phases
Canonical WETH and native full-address memecoin Autopilot control flow
Activity insertion failure before broadcast and recovery of the original signed trade
Lost broadcast response and identical-byte replay without a new signature
Confirmed execution followed by an interrupted activity confirmation
Durable confirmation write failure preserves recovery even though the memory mirror can advance
Owner pause and quote expiry prevent retry; a subsequent reverted receipt settles failed activity
Exactly one execution and one activity per recovered trade; no new AI entitlement consumed
arcWorkers.mode: Actual scheduler, policy, calldata, fees, private recovery and activity code with isolated storage/chain/provider fixtures; production readiness gate mocked

checks: New outbox instance restores the original signed transaction from encrypted storage
Wrong chain, signer, destination, value, gas and execution identity are rejected
Unavailable or missing durable storage cannot authorize broadcast
Tampered ciphertext and incompatible executor key fail closed without deleting recovery
A different pending transaction cannot be overwritten or deleted by stale settlement
outboxRegressionTests.mode: Real local fixture signatures and authenticated encryption; in-memory private KV adapter

appDocsBrowser.mode: Final production frontend with read-only local QA wallet; no production extension/email signing

operationalLimits: The original Arc route freshness limit remains enforced; expiry is never extended for recovery
Missing receipt evidence does not prove failure or authorize a fresh trade
Resolve pending records before rotating/removing the executor key; preserve private KV across restarts
An expired or invalid unresolved original transaction requires operator receipt/replacement/cancellation reconciliation
These offline regressions do not qualify production wallet signing or live deterministic risk-worker execution

releaseState.circleEmailWallets: disabled at user request while production setup is pending
remainingAcceptance: Remaining signed UI acceptance using production wallets
User's manual API/web release and approved activation
